claims.claim_text: On 4.8 I wouldn't suspect the software for this. Steady CRCs with the link up are usually a dirty connector, so clean both ends of the fibre and clear the counters, and if they're still climbing after ten minutes, try a new patch lead before you touch the optics.
claims.symptom: CRC errors climbing steadily while the link stays up
claims.action: Clean both ends of the fibre and clear the counters
claims.do_not_before: Don't touch the optics before trying a new patch lead
